note:
Ingrid, the integration slides now describe the estate we run. Two projects, eight tasks: olh_mcg_demo_cdc lands, stores and mirrors both CDC feeds, and MCG Supply Chain Pipeline builds silver and gold in Snowflake. Every proof slide is a clean tenant capture with notes telling the presenter what to point at. Where we have not finished, the deck says so in plain words: the Kafka streaming leg is built but not deployed, and the analytics apps still load QVD extracts rather than Snowflake gold. The latency, the CRM feed and the project count now agree with the captures. Both product SLAs are on the architecture slide.

The one gap left is real, not editorial. No slide can show Kafka telemetry landing until the streaming project is deployed. That and repointing the apps at Snowflake are the two things that would let this deck stop saying 'not yet'.

Slides 11 and 16 are trimmed of blank canvas only. Slide 20 now says on the slide that its image is two captures, one per project, top and bottom.

Slide 8's capture shows Running, 4,133 changes applied and 0 datasets in error. Slide 9's shows 129 records/s, latency 00:00:05 and 0 in error. Slides 12 and 13 show 3 datasets Completed, 0 in error, with the subtitles' table names. Slide 17 shows 7 datasets with 0 in error. Slide 18 shows both gold tables Completed. Slide 20's top half shows olh_mcg_demo_cdc's landing, storage and mirror tasks, and its bottom half shows the silver and gold transforms.

"PostgreSQL (WMS)" by "CDC via Data Movement gateway" with "inventory_positions • warehouse_events • shipments"; "Apache Kafka (IoT)" with "mcg.iot.cold-chain • mcg.iot.carrier-events", streamed to the lakehouse streaming cluster; "Meridian CRM (MySQL)" by "MySQL CDC (binlog) via Data Movement gateway, continuous" with "crm_contacts • crm_orders • crm_products".

"Local databases reach Qlik Cloud through a registered gateway"; "Paste the token, then wait for status Connected"; "Select the mcg-qlik-dmg gateway from the dropdown"; "the public REST API cannot create it".

Slide 19 lists "Declarative YAML definition", "Git version control + CI/CD" and "2 projects deployed from YAML". Slide 22 says "both deployed projects are declarative YAML in deploy/pipelines/ — API import, git round-trip".

"Qlik declarative-pipeline tooling is a Qlik internal preview (June 2026)" on slide 19, "MCP-server tooling is in Qlik preview (June 2026)" on slide 21, and "(QTCP preview)" on slide 22. The status is dated June: recheck it before the deck goes outside the company.

Slide 19: "2 projects deployed from YAML: olh_mcg_demo_cdc (6 tasks) + MCG Supply Chain Pipeline (2) = 8 tasks; the streaming project is built, not yet deployed". Slide 6: "the Kafka stream is built, not yet deployed". Slide 10: "streaming iot_cold_chain • iot_carrier_events not yet deployed" and "the analytics apps still load QVD extracts, not Snowflake gold". Slide 22: "both deployed projects are declarative YAML". This matches the tenant (olh_mcg_demo_cdc with 6 tasks, MCG Supply Chain Pipeline with 2, no streaming project) and the olh_live probe (12 lib:// .qvd reads in app1 and app2).

Slide 19's "2 projects deployed from YAML" agrees with slide 20's "Both Pipeline Projects". Slide 10's bronze "(6 tables)" matches the mirror's six, and silver's "(7 tables)" matches slide 17.
